about: The models the runner knows. Add one entry to add a model: `bench.py llm <name>` / `bench.py inside <name>` then use it, and `bench.py score` picks up its raw files (b_<name>_<set>.jsonl.gz, c_<name>_<set>.jsonl.gz) and prints it under `label`. base_url and key_env are optional (default: OpenRouter, $OPENROUTER_API_KEY); extra is merged into every request; price_in / price_out ($ per 1M tokens) are only a fallback for an endpoint that does not report usage.cost.
